title: Explicit bad-prior trimming yields a cube-root cloning/estimation bound

statement.quantifiers: Finite pure ensemble, global TWO-COPY cloner fidelity Fcl, single-copy EB estimation fidelity FEB,e=1-Fcl.
statement.assertion: 1-FEB<=min(1,64 e^(1/3)); for small e choose t=e^(2/3), badmass<=e/t and good CBdelta=2sqrt(2t).
assumptions: Badness is per-label GLOBAL cloning infidelity, not marginal infidelity.

inputs: Precisely specified operators, quantum channel/pure family and source hypotheses.
outputs: Scoped analytical reduction/candidate assertion with source review boundary.
interface.precision: Source constants, supports, reference and fidelity conventions retained; no external/formal/priority certificate.
costs: Whole-domain EB construction on good set; no practical compiler or mixed-state generalization.

proof_mechanism: Markov removes bad labels before uniform CB estimate.
obstructions: No sharp exponent/constant or linear-eight inequality; known finite counterexamples remain valid.

potential_uses.target: Explicit bad-prior trimming yields a cube-root cloning/estimation bound
potential_uses.transfer_gate: Match exact source interfaces and independently validate full proof/source version and acquired computational costs before transfer.

review.source_reported: Supplied AI-assisted component/adversarial audit, not external independent review. No intake analytic reconstruction; exact adaptive finite reruns do not certify this pure-family mechanism.
